title: Multi-target benchmark of skill-file-guided agentic virtual screening across eleven drug targets
description: Reproducibility package for the manuscript "Virtual ligand screening by LLM agents: expert guidance changes the screened library, not the ranking" (sole author, submitted to Journal of Cheminformatics, October 2026). Contents: the 202-line virtual-screening skill file (SKILL.md), the verbatim agent prompts, the agent-generated parameterised pipeline for eleven protein targets across six classes (FPR2, EGFR, CDK2, COX-2, ESR1, DPP-4, AChE, BACE-1, HSP90, p38, thrombin), the analysis scripts for both evaluation populations, the four-condition component decomposition with its protocol and score tables, the decoy-set and docking-score audits, the early-recognition metric panel, the figure scripts and an environment lockfile. REVISION_2026.md states which tables reproduce from the companion data deposit alone.
